# dynUtils

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan 2026-06-09

## Description

Utility functions for data preparation when fitting dynamic models.

## Installation

You can install the released version of `dynUtils` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/jeksterslab/dynUtils) with:

``` r

if (!require("remotes")) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("jeksterslab/dynUtils")
```

## More Information

See [GitHub Pages](https://jeksterslab.github.io/dynUtils) for package
documentation.

## References

R Core Team. (2023). *R: A language and environment for statistical
computing*. R Foundation for Statistical Computing.
<https://www.R-project.org/>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`DeleteInitialNA()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/dynUtils/reference/DeleteInitialNA.md)
  : Delete for NAs in Initial Row By ID

- [`InitialNA()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/dynUtils/reference/InitialNA.md)
  : Check for NAs in Initial Row By ID

- [`InsertNA()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/dynUtils/reference/InsertNA.md)
  : Insert NAs for Missing Observations

- [`ScaleByID()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/dynUtils/reference/ScaleByID.md)
  : Scale by ID

- [`SubsetByID()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/dynUtils/reference/SubsetByID.md)
  : Subset Data Set by ID

- [`print(`*`<dynutillist>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/dynUtils/reference/print.dynutillist.md)
  :

  Print Method for Object of Class `dynutillist`
